question: Can full shank length L2 and cuff fraction f be separately recovered when they appear as sc=f*L2, and can the absolute in-plane q1 zero be recovered without a calibrated Human sagittal basis or known-q pose?
allowed_observations: calibrated world vertical and motion-plane normal, but no calibrated in-plane sagittal zero
structural_equivalence_rule: Hold sc=f*L2 fixed while varying L2 and f inside (0,1).
pass_rule: SEPARATELY_IDENTIFIABLE only if the stacked observation Jacobian with respect to [L2,f] has rank 2, no distinct legal pair reproduces all cuff kinematics/generalized effects, and no rotated-basis/shifted-q gauge reproduces the world cuff pose and Jacobian.
failure_rule: NON_IDENTIFIABLE if either exact gauge exists and changes a control-critical downstream quantity or absolute Human state convention.
